items.title: Peter Erskine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: One of the gigs was a private birthday party for Ray Kroc, the founder of McDonald’s.

ctx.x: Yeah. But Willie was on the band and he was a character.

Yeah. Basically, I mean I didn’t learn — I mean how do you learn from something, if someone says, “If it’s good for you it’s bad for you.” That was one of the things he used to say. He loved the color orange. He hated the color green. He wouldn’t eat green vegetables. He hated McDonald’s. At one point it was in the fall of ’72 and Stan was in the hospital recovering from an aneurysm. And that was a tough time for the band, it was difficult. One of the gigs was a private birthday party for Ray Kroc, the founder of…
That’s serious. Wow. Great story. Was it hard to leave? You went from Kenton to Maynard Ferguson, right?
